title: Product Stock Update
bodyHtml:
Product Stock Update

This is to bring to the notice of all that hard bound copy of the Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP-2022) (04 Volumes set) is OUT OF STOCK NOW. Therefore, IPC will not accept any order for purchase of the IP-2022. Please do not make any payment to the IPC for purchasing IP-2022.

However, Addendum 2024 to IP-2022 which is effective from 01st July 2024 is available for purchase and details in this regard are available on our website (https://www.ipc.gov.in)
